material.acceptance_criteria: fillFor (ui_minimap.js:75-78) returns a distinct value for the selected state that is neither OWN_FILL nor the player colour, so a selected own unit and an unselected own unit have different fills, and a selected enemy is not drawn in the own colour.
material.description: Principle DADA_CRAP (Contrast, Williams). js/client/ui_minimap.js:76 returns OWN_FILL (#ffffff, ui_minimap.js:11) when u.id === active, and ui_minimap.js:78 returns the same OWN_FILL for every unit with u.player === me. Selection and own-unit share one fill: selecting an own unit changes nothing on the minimap, and selecting an enemy or neutral unit paints it in the own colour. Witness: codesearch dispatch 1792858709793-5767-ab6825f62c68d61c.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: ui_minimap.js:76 returns OWN_FILL when u.id === active, and :78 returns OWN_FILL for own units (fillFor :75-79). Observable: selecting an own unit changes nothing on the minimap; selecting an enemy or neutral unit turns its dot white, the own colour. Read: ui_minimap.js 75-79 dispatch 1792859774996-6585-f992fb64226fa674 (session verify-DADA_CRAP-trav-minimap-camera-2).

material.subject: Selected unit on the minimap is drawn exactly like every other own unit
material.witness: Live Chrome, session verify-DADA_CRAP-trav-minimap-camera-1, sha 8d102946: selected own unit (id 2) draws #f2d84c (was #ffffff before selection); selected enemy (id 3, dispatch 1792863404143-5206-ca2885a3f5a7a763) draws #f2d84c, not its player colour. CI: ci workflow success on 8d102946.
material.witness_plan: codesearch on js/client/ui_minimap.js for the selected-state constant returns a hit distinct from OWN_FILL; a live minimap with one own unit selected shows a different pixel colour at its dot than an unselected own unit.
